hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; c=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain --ignored -- nueravix-x/tools nueravix-x/Makefile | grep -v "__pycache__/"); if [ -n "$c" ] || ! git -C "$d" diff --quiet origin/bootstrap -- nueravix-x/tools nueravix-x/Makefile .claude/settings.json; then echo "blocked: nueravix-x/tools, nueravix-x/Makefile or .claude/settings.json differ from origin/bootstrap" >&2; exit 2; fi
